metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU SHEUNG v. PA LING LOGISTICS COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: casual delivery worker; lorry driver cum delivery worker

injuries.description: fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula with two 1 cm wounds over the fracture
source: Doctors at the orthopaedics department of KWH found that the plaintiff had suffered from fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula with two 1 cm wounds over the fracture. Intramedullary nailing of the left tibia was performed on 21 August 2014.

injuries.description: contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement
source: The plaintiff also sustained contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement in the Accident;
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: wound infection / abscess over left shin requiring debridement
source: an abscess was found over his left shin. Debridement was performed on 31 October 2014. His wound was found to have been infected and antibiotics was prescribed as treatment.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Shing Ching v Hong Kong District Security Ltd and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture at his right tibia and fibular. Wound debridement and application of external skeletal fixator was done, which was followed by the removal of external fixator and intramedullary nailing of the right tibia. After discharge, he was admitted again for treatment of skin graft wound infection. He was confined to a wheelchair for 4 months after the accident. Thereafter he had to walk with a walking frame or walking sticks.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ko Chu Keung v Temmuk Engineering Co Ltd And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of the right tibia and fibula, with a 10 cm x 4 cm contaminated open wound over the right leg with exposed bone. Wound irrigation, tetanus prophylaxis, intravenous antibiotics and skin traction were given. Operation under the general anesthesia with intramedullary nailing of the right tibia and plating of the right fibula was performed. A second debridement operation was performed in view of the contaminated open fracture wound. Subsequently, the implant and the stitches were removed.

comparable_cases.case_name: Sukhdeep Singh v Chow Kin Hung And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured distal tibia and fibula of the right leg, underwent surgery for open reduction and internal fixation of the fibula and nailing of the tibia. Bone was taken from his right knee for grafting. Later, he was re-admitted for the removal of the surgical implant due to continue pain and discomfort over the right knee area where the bone graft had been taken.
